newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers steady, but demand picks up.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers steady, but demand picks up.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices barely changed on Tuesday, but traded volumes picked up sharply from Monday's calm, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 cst fuel oil was quoted in the range $87/$88 fob, as on Monday, with a number of enquiries being fixed at $87, only $1 above the barge quotation. A number of independent suppliers said they were unable to compete at such levels.
"We've seen quite a lot of enquiries, but the numbers are just way too low," one supplier said.
After a dull Monday, bunker demand improved. Some traders said Tuesday's traded volume topped 20,000 tonnes.
Hamburg fuel oil was steady and demand, though better than on Monday, was unexceptional.
Mediterranean fuel oil prices were steady, but gas oil dipped by about $1.
An exception was Piraeus where some unscheduled refinery maintenance meant prices rose. Supplies before the middle of the month were hard to find.
